nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

widgets_values:
## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (2.62 GB)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) (577.2 MB)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (19.53 GB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (14.61 GB)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.82 GB)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Han Li, the lean sixteen-year-old village boy in <Picture 1>; his face, hairstyle, build, and clothing follow <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is Doctor Mo, the gaunt elderly physician in <Picture 2>; his face, hairstyle, build, and clothing follow <Picture 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] On a cracked wasteland plain under blazing midday sun, <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> fight a fifteen-second cinematic sword duel: a silent standoff, a simultaneous charge, three rapid blade clashes under a full orbiting camera, a spinning mid-air crossing slash, a landing shockwave that splits the ground, and a final crossed-blade freeze. <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> anchor the two fighters' identities in every shot; the environment, weapons, and effects are newly generated.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - his facial identity, hairstyle, build, and clothing follow <Picture 1> in every shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - his facial identity, hairstyle, build, and clothing follow <Picture 2> in every shot.

detailed_description:
Cinematic live-action xianxia sword duel with anamorphic flares and faint film grain. A blazing white midday sun hangs high overhead, throwing short hard shadows beneath the fighters across the wide cracked-clay plain.

[Shot 1] The camera glides forward at ground level at slow speed, then arcs slowly around the pair: <Subject 1> stands frame-left facing right, a silver-white longsword sheathed at his left hip; <Subject 2> stands frame-right facing left, a long crimson sword held low. Thirty paces of cracked clay lie between them, dust dragged into low ribbons by a steady wind from frame-left; their hems, hair and the old man's grey goatee all stream right, and a skein of dark birds crosses the pale blue sky. Both stances sink in the last beat: <Subject 1>'s rear foot grinds back, knuckles whitening on the hilt [lead].

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a fast side-on tracking shot at the duelists' sprinting speed. Both launch together: <Subject 1> drives off his back foot, knees low, angled into the charge; <Subject 2> eats the ground in longer prowling bounds, gown snapping. [2.4s] two steel rings land almost together as the blades clear their scabbards, the boy drawing left-handed; dust bursts at every footfall, the gap closing to two paces, both swords waking first threads of silver-white and red light.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot opens on an extreme close-up of the two blades meeting at chest height - [4.2s] the first clash, sparks sheeting off the grind; the camera whips back and circles the pair counterclockwise with large amplitude at fast speed, one full orbit through the remaining clashes: [5.2s] second clash low, dust leaping off the ground in a ring; [6.2s] third clash locked blade-to-blade, feet ploughing twin furrows, comet tails of silver-white and crimson trailing each sword. Hard overhead sunlight flares through the hanging dust [reveal].

[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts low and pedestals up with a tilt up as both men leave the ground: <Subject 2> springs first, gown flaring, crimson blade sweeping a full overhead circle; <Subject 1> corkscrews up inside that arc, the silver-white sword tracing a rising spiral. From [8.0s] half a second of slow motion: two rotating bodies cross in mid-air, blade edges dragging long silver-white and crimson tails through the dust. At [9.5s] speed snaps back and the cut falls earthward.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the camera drops to a low wide angle and pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed as both land: [10.3s] a double impact boom, a ring-shaped dust shockwave bursting from both landing points, cracks spiderwebbing outward through the clay. Dust thins in the same wind; harsh white sunlight glares back across the torn clay. From [13.0s] the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on the final hold: blades locked edge-to-edge between their faces, both figures edged sharp against the glaring pale sky, the anamorphic flare collapsing to a point as the last sparks die, the frame freezing on the crossed steel.

overall_soundscape:
A steady dry wind moans across the open plain throughout, with fine grit hissing over the cracked clay. Twin steel rings at [2.4s] as both blades clear their scabbards; three hard steel-on-steel cracks at [4.2s], [5.2s] and [6.2s], each with a short spark fizz; a deep double impact boom at [10.3s] followed by a gravel-rattle tail that decays under the wind as the dust settles.

non_diegetic_music:
A tight percussion-and-strings cue: a low two-note cello ostinato under the standoff, taiko-like hits landing on each blade clash, a rising string tremolo through the slow-motion mid-air crossing, and one final sustained low note that decays under the frozen final frame.
